title: Clarinet player Lorenzo Tio
summary: Henry names Lorenzo Tio as an outstanding clarinet player, though hard to hear in the band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Let's see. Any outstanding clarinet players? Or... Anybody who would make you cry, you know what I'm saying.
No, excuse me, but I'll tell you, Lorenzo Teo. He was a really outstanding class player.
What would he do at a funeral that would be a special?

Oh, that's all I had? Yeah. Well, he was a good man. You want to get on the job then? He was white. And you could hear him. He didn't like it for you. They got nothing. You can't hear him. Them families, they said, supposed to be above everything in the band. You couldn't hear him anyway. But somebody got on the piano, you can't hear him. From here to the door there. I wouldn't have him. Left him. Yeah. And then they'd do it.
